Drawing DWG-C-0002 rev A, sheet 1/1: System C – air path schematic.
Components:
- C-AIR: Air inlet filter
- C-BLW: Cathode air blower
- C-HUM: Membrane humidifier
- C-EXH: Exhaust outlet
- C-STK: Fuel cell stack
Line list:
- L01 Air from C-AIR (Air inlet filter) to C-BLW (Cathode air blower)
- L02 Air from C-BLW (Cathode air blower) to C-HUM (Membrane humidifier)
- L03 Humidified air from C-HUM (Membrane humidifier) to C-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L04 Cathode exhaust from C-STK (Fuel cell stack) to C-HUM (Membrane humidifier)
- L05 Cathode exhaust from C-HUM (Membrane humidifier) to C-EXH (Exhaust outlet)
Notes: Schematic, not to scale. Sensors and check valves are not shown.
